description: Load vet pack — authority + BASICs + broker + OFAC name. Pre-tender check: FMCSA authority and SMS BASICs (monthly snapshot) for the carrier, broker authority for broker_mc, OFAC name screen if a name is given. TENDER, HOLD or REJECT from public fields only, no fraud score. Freight carriers flag only on acute/critical violations (percentiles not public); a stale-data HOLD is labelled data-quality. Cites sources and as_of. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

broker_mc.description: broker MC/docket number — runs the FMCSA broker-authority check (optional)

dot.description: carrier USDOT number (optional; give dot, mc or broker_mc)

mc.description: carrier MC/docket number (optional; give dot, mc or broker_mc)
